title: marrubium supinum
intro: Marrubium supinum, commonly known as Hoary Marrubium, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its traditional use in herbal medicine, where it has been employed to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Marrubium supinum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Hoary Marrubium include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
